name: kb_29_Normalized

https:__kubernetesjsonschema_dev_master_.description: Time is a wrapper around time.Time which supports correct marshaling to YAML and JSON.  Wrappers are provided for many of the factory methods that the time package offers.

schema.description: APIServiceCondition describes the state of an APIService at a particular point

lastTransitionTime.description: Last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.

message.description: Human-readable message indicating details about last transition.

reason.description: Unique, one-word, CamelCase reason for the condition's last transition.

status.description: Status is the status of the condition. Can be True, False, Unknown.

type.description: Type is the type of the condition.

description: The APIService is currently in the **Available** condition with a status of **True**. The last transition to this state occurred at **2023-08-15T12:34:56Z**. The recorded reason for the transition is **ServiceReady**, and the accompanying message reads: “API service is available and responding.”

reference_json.message: API service is available and responding.
